table.retrieve:
SELECT /*opening cash/bank in hand balance*/
	glvochcode=Null, 
	debit=CASE WHEN b.bal >= 0 THEN b.bal ELSE 0 END,
	credit=CASE WHEN b.bal >= 0 THEN 0 ELSE ABS(b.bal) END,
	date = :ad_startDate,
	type = SPACE(100),
	remarks='Opening Balance',
	acc=SPACE(100),
	accounthead=SPACE(100),
	priority=-1
FROM
	(SELECT bal=sum(Debit-Credit) 
	FROM VirtualGl
	WHERE
		acccode in 
			(select acccode from accounts where subcode IN 
					(SELECT code FROM global WHERE LOWER(name) IN (LOWER('GT_CashSub')))) and
		date < :ad_startDate) B
UNION ALL
SELECT /*Cash/Bank Transaction Details debit=credit and credit=debit*/
	glvochcode=h.glvochcode,
	debit=d.credit,
	credit=d.debit,
	date = h.date,
	type = RTRIM(LTRIM(VC.SHORTNAME)) + '-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(7), h.glvochcode))),
	remarks=d.remarks,
	acc=(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode = h.acccode),
	accounthead= 
		CASE WHEN d.studentcode IS NULL THEN
			(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode = d.acccode) 
		ELSE 
			(SELECT name + ' (' + regno + ')' FROM student WHERE student.studentcode = d.studentcode)
		END,
	priority=0
FROM
	glheader h,
	gldetail d,
	vochercategory vc,
	accounts a
WHERE
	h.posted = 'Y' and
	h.glvochcode = d.glvochcode and
	h.vochcatcode = vc.vochcatcode and
	vc.journalvoucher = 0 and
	h.acccode in (select acccode from accounts where subcode IN 
							(SELECT code FROM global WHERE LOWER(name) IN (LOWER('GT_CashSub')))) and
	h.acccode <> d.acccode and 
	d.acccode = a.acccode and
	h.date BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_endDate
UNION ALL

	type = RTRIM(LTRIM(VC.SHORTNAME)) + '-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(7), h.glvochcode))),

 	d.acccode IN (Select a.acccode from accounts a where a.subcode IN 
						(select code from global where lower(name) in (lower('GT_CashSub')))) and 
	h.date BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_endDate
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	glvochcode=NULL,
	debit = ISNULL(SUM(S.Amt), 0),
	credit = 0,
	date = :ad_EndDate,
	type = 'CSH-SALE',
	remarks='Total Invoices: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT COUNT(SaleInvCode) FROM saleledger WHERE salecatcode = 3 and posted = 'Y' and accountfor='Y' and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) + 
			' (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT MIN(SaleInvCode) FROM saleledger WHERE salecatcode = 3 and posted = 'Y' and accountfor='Y' and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) +
			'-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT MAX(SaleInvCode) FROM saleledger WHERE salecatcode = 3 and posted = 'Y' and accountfor='Y' and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) + ')',
	acc=(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode IN (select code from global where lower(name) in (lower('GT_CashACC')))),
	accounthead='Cash Sale for the Period',
	priority=1
FROM
	(SELECT amt=ISNULL(Round(SUM(d.looseqty * d.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM(ROUND( (d.looseqty * 
				(d.saleprice - d.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * d.discperc)) * 
				d.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND( (SUM((d.looseqty * 
				(d.saleprice - d.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * d.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * h.discperc)) -
				h.flatdisc) * (h.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
			Round( SUM((d.looseqty * (d.saleprice - d.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * d.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * h.discperc)) + 
				h.misccharges + h.salestax - h.flatdisc, 0), 0)
	FROM
		saleledger h,
		saledetail d
	WHERE
		h.saleinvcode = d.saleinvcode and
		h.salecatcode = 3 and
		h.posted = 'Y' and 
		h.accountfor='Y' and
		h.date BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_endDate
	GROUP BY h.saleinvcode,
		 h.salecatcode, 
		 h.date,
		 h.discperc,
		 h.misccharges,
		 h.salestax,
		 h.InvGSTPerc1,
		 h.flatdisc) S 
HAVING SUM(S.Amt) <> 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	glvochcode=NULL,
	debit = ISNULL(SUM(S.Amt), 0),
	credit = 0,
	date = :ad_EndDate,

	acc=(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode IN (select code from global where lower(name) in (lower('GT_CashACC')))),
	accounthead='Credit Sale (Immediate Cash) for the Period',

FROM

			SUM(ROUND( (d.looseqty * 
				(d.saleprice - d.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * d.discperc)) * 
				d.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND( (SUM((d.looseqty * 
				(d.saleprice - d.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * d.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * h.discperc)) -
				h.flatdisc) * (h.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
			Round( SUM((d.looseqty * (d.saleprice - d.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * d.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * h.discperc)) + 
				h.misccharges + h.salestax - h.flatdisc, 0), 0)

		 h.discperc,
		 h.misccharges,
		 h.salestax,

SELECT 
	glvochcode=NULL,
	debit = ISNULL(SUM(S.Amt), 0),
	credit = 0,
	date = :ad_EndDate,
	type = 'CSH-SALE',
	remarks='Total Invoices: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT COUNT(SaleInvCode) FROM saleledger WHERE salecatcode in (1,2) and posted = 'Y' and accountfor='Y' and amt <> 0 and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) + 
			' (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT MIN(SaleInvCode) FROM saleledger WHERE salecatcode IN (1, 2) and posted = 'Y' and accountfor='Y' and amt <> 0 and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) +
			'-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT MAX(SaleInvCode) FROM saleledger WHERE salecatcode IN (1, 2) and posted = 'Y' and accountfor='Y' and amt <> 0 and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) + ')',
	acc=(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode IN (select code from global where lower(name) in (lower('GT_CashACC')))),
	accounthead='Received during credit sale for the Period',
	priority=3
FROM
	(SELECT amt=ISNULL(sum(h.amt), 0) + ISNULL(sum(h.cashcharged), 0)
	FROM
		saleledger h
	WHERE
		h.salecatcode IN (1, 2) and
		h.posted = 'Y' and 
		h.accountfor='Y' and
		h.date BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_endDate AND
		(h.paymentacccode in (select acccode from accounts where subcode IN 
							(SELECT code FROM global WHERE LOWER(name) IN (LOWER('GT_CashSub')))) OR
		h.cashacccode in (select acccode from accounts where subcode IN 
							(SELECT code FROM global WHERE LOWER(name) IN (LOWER('GT_CashSub')))))
	) S
HAVING SUM(S.Amt) > 0
UNION ALL

	date = :ad_EndDate,

			'-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT MAX(SrInvCode) FROM srledger WHERE srcatcode = 8 and posted = 'Y' and accountfor='Y' and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) + ')',

		h.accountfor = 'Y' and
		h.date BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_endDate

		 h.discperc,
		 h.misccharges,
		 h.salestax,
		 h.InvGSTPerc1,

SELECT

	Debit  = 0,
	Credit = ISNULL(SUM(S.Amt), 0),
	date = :ad_EndDate,
	type = 'CSH-SR',
	remarks='Total Invoices: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT COUNT(SRInvCode) FROM srledger WHERE srcatcode IN (6, 7) and posted = 'Y' and accountfor='Y' and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) +

			'-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT MAX(SrInvCode) FROM srledger WHERE srcatcode IN (6,7) and posted = 'Y' and accountfor='Y' and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) + ')',

	accounthead='Paid during Credit S/Return for the Period',

	FROM
		srledger h
	WHERE
		h.srcatcode IN (6,7) and
		h.posted = 'Y' and 
		h.accountfor='Y' and
		h.date BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_endDate AND
		h.paymentacccode in (select acccode from accounts where subcode IN 
							(SELECT code FROM global WHERE LOWER(name) IN (LOWER('GT_CashSub'))))) S

SELECT 
	glvochcode=H.ServiceInvCode,
	Debit  = CASE WHEN H.ServiceCatCode = 10 THEN H.InvTotal ELSE H.CashCharged END,
	Credit = 0,
	date = H.Date,
	type = 'SVC-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(7), H.ServiceInvCode))),
	remarks=h.remarks,
	acc=(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode = h.cashacccode),
	accounthead=	CASE WHEN h.studentcode IS NULL THEN
			(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode = h.custcode) 
		ELSE 
			(SELECT name + ' (' + regno + ')' FROM student WHERE student.studentcode = h.studentcode)
		END,
	priority=7
FROM
	serviceheader h
WHERE
	(h.CashCharged > 0 OR H.ServiceCatCode = 10) and
	h.posted = 'Y' and
	h.date BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_EndDate
UNION ALL
SELECT

	date = H.Date,
	type = 'SVCR-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(7), H.ServiceRInvCode))),
	remarks=h.remarks,
	acc=(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode = h.cashacccode),
	accounthead=	CASE WHEN h.studentcode IS NULL THEN
			(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode = h.custcode) 
		ELSE 
			(SELECT name + ' (' + regno + ')' FROM student WHERE student.studentcode = h.studentcode)
		END,
	priority=7
FROM
	servicerheader h
WHERE
	(h.CashCharged > 0 OR H.ServiceRCatCode = 13) and
	h.posted = 'Y' and
	h.date BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_EndDate
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	glvochcode=NULL,
	Debit  = 0,  
	Credit = ISNULL(SUM(P.Amt), 0),
	date = :ad_EndDate,
	type = 'CSH-PUR',
	remarks='Total Invoices: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT COUNT(PurInvCode) FROM Purledger WHERE posted = 'Y' and accountfor='Y' and amt <> 0 and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) + 
			' (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT MIN(PurInvCode) FROM Purledger WHERE posted = 'Y' and accountfor='Y' and amt <> 0 and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) +
			'-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT MAX(PurInvCode) FROM Purledger WHERE posted = 'Y' and accountfor='Y' and amt <> 0 and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) + ')',
	acc=(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode IN (select code from global where lower(name) in (lower('GT_CashACC')))),
	accounthead='Paid During Purchase for the Period',
	priority=13
FROM
	(SELECT amt=ISNULL(SUM(h.amt), 0)
	FROM
		purledger h
	WHERE
		h.posted = 'Y' and 
		h.accountfor='Y' and
		h.amt <> 0 and 
		h.date BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_endDate AND 
	 	h.paymentacccode IN (Select a.acccode from accounts a where a.subcode IN 
						(select code from global where lower(name) in (lower('GT_CashSub') ))) 
	HAVING ISNULL(SUM(H.Amt), 0) > 0) P
HAVING SUM(P.Amt) <> 0

	accounthead='Received during Cash P/Return for the Period',
	priority=15

	FROM
		prledger h
	WHERE
		h.posted = 'Y' and 
		h.amt <> 0 
		and h.accountfor = 'Y' and
		h.date BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_endDate) P 
HAVING SUM(P.Amt) > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT /*Sales Receivable Adjustments*/
	glvochcode=NULL,
	debit=SUM(d.debit),
	credit=SUM(d.credit),
	date = :ad_endDate,
	type = 'SRADJ',
	remarks='Sales Receivable Amount Adjustment',
	acc=(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode = d.acccode),
	accounthead=(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode = d.acccode),
	priority=16
FROM
	saleledger sl, salereceivableadj d, accounts a
WHERE
	sl.posted = 'Y' and
	sl.date BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_endDate and
	sl.saleinvcode = d.saleinvcode and
	d.acccode in 
		(select acccode from accounts 
		where subcode IN 
			(SELECT code FROM global WHERE LOWER(name) IN (LOWER('GT_CashSub')))) and
	d.acccode = a.acccode
GROUP BY
	d.acccode
UNION ALL
SELECT /*Post Dated Cheques*/
	glvochcode=notes.NoteCode,
	debit=CASE WHEN notes.NoteCatCode = 1 THEN notes.Amount ELSE 0 END,
	credit=CASE WHEN notes.NoteCatCode = 2 THEN notes.Amount ELSE 0 END,
	date = notes.PostDate,
	type = CASE WHEN notes.NoteCatCode = 1 THEN 'NR' ELSE 'NP' END + '-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(Notes.VoucherCode, 10))),
	remarks=notes.Remarks,
	acc=(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode = notes.BankAcccode),
	accounthead=(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode = notes.acccode),
	priority=17
FROM
	Notes
WHERE
	notes.posted = 'Y' and
	notes.PostDate BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_endDate and
	notes.BankAcccode in 
		(select acccode from accounts 
		where subcode IN 
			(SELECT code FROM global WHERE LOWER(name) IN (LOWER('GT_CashSub'))))
UNION ALL
SELECT /*Post Dated Cheques*/
	glvochcode=notes.NoteCode,
	debit=CASE WHEN notes.NoteCatCode = 1 THEN 0 ELSE notes.Amount  END,
	credit=CASE WHEN notes.NoteCatCode = 2 THEN 0 ELSE notes.Amount END,
	date = notes.PostDate,
	type = CASE WHEN notes.NoteCatCode = 1 THEN 'NR' ELSE 'NP' END + '-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(Notes.VoucherCode, 10))),
	remarks=notes.Remarks,
	acc=(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode = notes.Acccode),
	accounthead=(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode = notes.BankAcccode),
	priority=18
FROM
	Notes
WHERE
	notes.posted = 'Y' and
	notes.PostDate BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_endDate and
	notes.Acccode in 
		(select acccode from accounts 
		where subcode IN 
			(SELECT code FROM global WHERE LOWER(name) IN (LOWER('GT_CashSub'))))
ORDER BY 
	date, 
	priority, 
	type

objects.name: c_openbalance
objects.expression: abs(cumulativeSum( debit - credit for all ) + credit - debit )

objects.name: compute_5
objects.expression: if( cumulativeSum( debit - credit for all ) + credit - debit >= 0, '', 'Cr.')

objects.name: compute_3
objects.expression: if( cumulativeSum( debit - credit for all ) >= 0, 'Dr.', 'Cr.')

objects.name: compute_4
objects.expression: abs( cumulativeSum( debit - credit for all ) )

objects.name: c_sreceived
objects.expression: sum( case( remarks when 'Opening Balance' then 0 else debit) for all)

objects.name: c_spayed
objects.expression: sum( case( remarks when 'Opening Balance' then 0 else credit) for all)

objects.name: c_currbalcrbr
objects.expression: if( cumulativeSum( debit - credit for all ) >= 0, '', 'Cr.')
